definition: This dimension controls how players retain or lose progress across playthroughs in games featuring permadeath, affecting the balance of risk and reward. It varies from complete resets on death to partial retention of resources, abilities, or knowledge gained during previous runs.
exclusion_criteria: Games that reset all character progress upon death
Titles that do not feature any form of persistent advancement beyond a single playthrough
inclusion_criteria: Games that allow players to unlock new classes or abilities after multiple runs
Titles that provide persistent upgrades or resources that carry over to subsequent games
title: Meta-Progression in Permadeath Contexts
